name: Cardling
look: a cute round red cardinal with a pointed crest, a stubby grey beak in a little black mask, big shiny eyes, pink blush, a white belly and white spots on its wings
entry: It sings sweetly from the branches at dawn, and its song is said to bring good luck to anyone who hears it first thing in the morning. It is tiny, round and fearless.
how: Wild: common in forests, plains and grasslands.
